rows.name: West Virginia Board of Medicine
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines West Virginia's physicians and podiatrists. Fifteen members — fourteen appointed by the Governor with Senate consent plus the State Health Officer ex officio (W. Va. Code 30-3-5).
rows.criticalNote: 14 of 15 seats are governor-appointed (State Health Officer serves ex officio)

rows.name: West Virginia Board of Examiners for Registered Professional Nurses
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates West Virginia's registered professional nurses. Seven members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — an APRN, a dialysis technician, four registered nurses, and one citizen member (W. Va. Code 30-7-3).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the West Virginia Code; WV publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: West Virginia Board of Pharmacy
rows.constituent: West Virginia patients & licensed pharmacists · drug safety
rows.mandate: Licenses pharmacists and regulates pharmacy practice in West Virginia. Seven members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — five licensed pharmacists and two citizen members (W. Va. Code 30-5-5).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the West Virginia Code; WV publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: West Virginia Real Estate Commission
rows.constituent: West Virginia home buyers & licensed brokers
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates West Virginia's real estate brokers and salespersons. Five members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — four licensees and one citizen member (W. Va. Code 30-40-6).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the West Virginia Code; WV publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: West Virginia Natural Resources Commission
rows.mandate: Sets policy for West Virginia's wildlife, parks, and natural resources. Seven commissioners appointed by the Governor with Senate consent, one per DNR district and the rest at large (W. Va. Code 20-1-16).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the West Virginia Code; WV publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
